nodes.name: capture.rs
nodes.summary: Snapshot-creation and per-file capture logic for the per-session file-history system: reads current file bytes, hashes and backs them up, and records the capture in a session's FileSnapshot manifest.

nodes.name: capture_file
nodes.summary: Captures a single file's current bytes into the content-addressed backup pool, returning a FileBackup record (or an untrackable marker if the file doesn't exist or isn't a regular file).

nodes.name: make_snapshot
nodes.summary: Creates and persists a new, empty FileSnapshot manifest for a session with a fresh snapshot id and timestamp.

nodes.name: make_tool_snapshot
nodes.summary: Creates a snapshot and immediately captures a batch of files into it in one call, used by tool-call-scoped edits.

nodes.name: track_edit_from_bytes
nodes.summary: Captures a file's pre-edit backup from an in-memory byte buffer (rather than re-reading disk) and records it in the given snapshot.

nodes.name: track_new_file
nodes.summary: Records that a file is newly created in this snapshot (an 'untrackable' backup marker so rewind knows to delete it on restore).

nodes.name: track_edit
nodes.summary: Captures a file's current on-disk bytes as its pre-edit backup and records it into the given snapshot before an edit tool mutates it.

nodes.name: cleanup.rs
nodes.summary: Eviction, blob garbage-collection, orphan-session pruning, and TTL-based pruning for the file-history storage: keeps per-session manifest/backup counts and disk footprint bounded.

nodes.name: remove_session
nodes.summary: Deletes an entire session's file-history directory (backups + snapshots).

nodes.name: prune_orphan_sessions
nodes.summary: Deletes file-history directories for sessions that no longer exist in the live session set.

nodes.name: evict_old_manifests_for_session
nodes.summary: Evicts the oldest snapshot manifests/DB rows for a session once it exceeds MAX_SNAPSHOTS_PER_SESSION, then runs blob GC.

nodes.name: discard_tool_call_snapshots
nodes.summary: Deletes all snapshots associated with a specific tool_call_id (used to discard a rejected/aborted tool call's captured state) and runs blob GC.

nodes.name: gc_unreferenced_blobs
nodes.summary: Scans a session's backup pool and deletes content-addressed blob files no longer referenced by any remaining snapshot manifest.

nodes.name: enforce_session_cap_after_save
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that runs evict_old_manifests_for_session after a new snapshot is saved, ignoring eviction errors.

nodes.name: prune_old_file_history
nodes.summary: Sweeps every session directory and removes sessions whose newest snapshot is older than max_age_days (TTL-based pruning), returning aggregate stats.

nodes.name: debug_seed.rs
nodes.summary: Debug-only synthetic seed helpers (gated on debug_assertions) exposed via /agent/test/housekeeping/* endpoints, letting housekeeping E2E tests deterministically populate manifests, DB rows, and aged session directories without exercising the real capture path.

nodes.name: debug_seed_manifests
nodes.summary: Synthetically creates a batch of snapshot manifests (and matching DB rows) for a session with configurable creation-time offsets, for deterministic housekeeping tests.

nodes.name: debug_seed_aged_session
nodes.summary: Synthetically creates a session whose newest snapshot is artificially aged by age_days, for TTL-pruning test coverage.

nodes.name: inspect.rs
nodes.summary: Diff and change-detection helpers that compare captured snapshots against current on-disk state (unified diff, numstat, has-changes checks) — pure read side of the file-history system.

nodes.name: has_any_changes
nodes.summary: Reports whether a snapshot recorded any file changes at all.

nodes.name: rewind_snapshot_ids
nodes.summary: Computes the ordered set of snapshot ids that would be rewound to reach a target created-at timestamp.

nodes.name: has_changes_after_message
nodes.summary: Reports whether any snapshot exists after a given message timestamp for a session.

nodes.name: session_unified_diff
nodes.summary: Builds a unified diff string across all tracked file changes in a session, comparing each backup against the current on-disk content.

nodes.name: session_numstat
nodes.summary: Computes per-file added/removed line counts (git numstat style) across all tracked changes in a session.

nodes.name: get_diff_stats
nodes.summary: Returns aggregate DiffStats (files changed/added/deleted) for a specific snapshot.

nodes.name: file_differs
nodes.summary: Compares a FileBackup's recorded hash against the current on-disk file content to determine if it changed.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root of the per-session file-copy snapshot system that replaced the legacy per-project shadow-git snapshot (which caused multi-session data loss); re-exports the public capture/inspect/rewind/cleanup API from its submodules and hosts the module's integration tests.

nodes.name: paths.rs
nodes.summary: Path helpers and manifest JSON I/O — the shared kernel that every other file_history submodule goes through to read or write a FileSnapshot manifest and its content-addressed backup blobs under ~/.orgii/file-history/<session_id>/.

nodes.name: session_root
nodes.summary: Builds the filesystem root path for a session's file-history directory.

nodes.name: backups_dir
nodes.summary: Builds the path to a session's content-addressed backups directory.

nodes.name: snapshots_dir
nodes.summary: Builds the path to a session's snapshot manifests directory.

nodes.name: snapshot_file
nodes.summary: Builds the path to a specific snapshot manifest JSON file.

nodes.name: backup_file
nodes.summary: Builds the path to a specific content-hash-addressed backup blob file.

nodes.name: ensure_dirs
nodes.summary: Creates a session's backups and snapshots directories if they don't already exist.

nodes.name: hash_bytes
nodes.summary: Computes the content hash used to address a backup blob.

nodes.name: new_snapshot_id
nodes.summary: Generates a new unique snapshot id.

nodes.name: now_iso
nodes.summary: Returns the current timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

nodes.name: write_snapshot
nodes.summary: Serializes and writes a FileSnapshot manifest to its JSON file, creating parent directories as needed.

nodes.name: read_snapshot
nodes.summary: Reads and deserializes a session's snapshot manifest JSON file.

nodes.name: manifest_snapshots
nodes.summary: Iterates a session's snapshots directory, reading and deserializing every manifest into (id, FileSnapshot) pairs sorted appropriately for eviction/pruning.

nodes.name: list_snapshot_ids_at_or_after
nodes.summary: Returns the ids of all snapshots created at or after a given timestamp.

nodes.name: latest_snapshot_id_before
nodes.summary: Returns the id of the most recent snapshot created strictly before a given timestamp.

nodes.name: read_snapshot_created_at
nodes.summary: Reads just the created_at timestamp field of a snapshot manifest without deserializing backups.
